package.name: swerve_cooptrans_bridge
package.description: Bidirectional adapter between the cooptrans cooperative-transport controller and one swerve robot's steering/drive hardware. Registers each swerve module as a nonholonomic agent: converts the controller's world-frame steering rate into a chassis-frame steer angle, and synthesises the per-agent pose topic the controller expects from payload mocap plus steering encoders.
